diagnosis: The Turborepo remote cache download handler validates that the request has a Turborepo bearer token, but looks up and streams the artifact purely by its hash. It ignores the teamId query parameter or fails to verify that the requesting token belongs to the team that generated the artifact. In shared or self-hosted remote cache servers, a developer from one team can download another team's compiled build outputs containing bundled secrets, proprietary binaries, and source maps.
exploit_request:
GET /v2/artifacts/a1b2c3d4e5f6789012345678abcdef0123456789?teamId=team_fintech_core HTTP/1.1
Host: turbo-cache.company.internal
Authorization: Bearer turbo_token_team_public_web
